scope: National mapped ethanol-plant layer, including operating, construction and expansion source records
coordinate_availability: Latitude/longitude attributes and point geometry published for every row
technology_or_process_fields: Explicit plant type, source situation and ethanol/cane/corn capacity fields
rights_status: EPE site content is CC BY 4.0
access_mechanism: Public ArcGIS REST query and EPE Webmap download interface
systematic_selection: All rows in layer 0; no name, size, status or route filter
rationale: Material new South American geographic coverage; fermentation and equipment are not inferred from the ethanol product label.

coordinate_availability: Latitude/longitude attributes and point geometry published for every row
technology_or_process_fields: Explicit biodiesel plant classification, ANP commercial-authorization field and capacity
rights_status: EPE site content is CC BY 4.0
access_mechanism: Public ArcGIS REST query and EPE Webmap download interface

official_source: EPA Landfill Methane Outreach Program operational projects map
scope: Operational municipal-solid-waste landfill gas energy projects in the September 2024 map release
coordinate_availability: EPA-published latitude/longitude and point geometry; EPA cautions that a point may be a landfill centre or entrance
technology_or_process_fields: Explicit energy-use category, project technology, capacity, LFG flow, parties and start date
rights_status: Data.gov catalogue assigns CC0 1.0; ArcGIS item states US EPA public-use data licence
access_mechanism: Public ArcGIS FeatureServer and official EPA pages
systematic_selection: All rows in the operational-project feature layer
rationale: Process-depth complement to the existing livestock-digester layer; voluntary database is not exhaustive and landfill digestion is not represented as a vessel.

official_source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy biogas plants geodata
scope: Biogas energy-production plants based on feed-in-remuneration recipients
coordinate_availability: Downloadable national geodata with plant points
technology_or_process_fields: Biogas production by fermentation is explicit in the dataset description
rights_status: opendata.swiss terms indicate open use with attribution
systematic_selection: Would require all published plant points and source plant categories
rationale: Round 4 already adds Swiss industrial geography; a later process layer should audit duplicate recipients, current-status semantics and stable identifiers before import.

scope: Point locations of regional bioenergy plants
systematic_selection: Would require an explicit source classification rule separating biogas from other biomass
rationale: Legally reusable and coordinate-bearing, but less geographic gain than the national imports and not yet audited for facility/phase duplicates.

official_source: IEA Hydrogen Production and Infrastructure Projects Database
scope: Global announced and operating hydrogen projects with route, product, capacity and status
coordinate_availability: Interactive map exists; downloadable row-level coordinate provenance was not established
technology_or_process_fields: Route and downstream products can include ammonia and methanol
access_mechanism: Free account/IP-authenticated workbook and interactive tools
systematic_selection: Would require all production records with source coordinates
import_decision: BACKLOG — access and coordinate audit unresolved
rationale: Rights are clear, but a credential-free deterministic input and coordinate-bearing schema were not established.

official_source: U.S. DOE NETL worldwide gasification plant database
scope: Global gasification projects with process type, feedstock and products
coordinate_availability: Reviewed tables do not provide a reusable facility-coordinate field
technology_or_process_fields: Gasifier type, number, feedstock and product can be explicit
rights_status: Government-hosted, but dataset-specific redistribution terms were not established
systematic_selection: Would select chemical/ammonia/methanol products from explicit source fields
import_decision: BACKLOG — no reusable coordinate-bearing bulk source
rationale: Process depth is high, but geocoding cities or assuming public-domain status would violate this round's rules.

scope: Named refineries and detailed downstream process-unit capacities
coordinate_availability: Facility spreadsheet lacks a confirmed source latitude/longitude field
technology_or_process_fields: Atmospheric distillation, cracking, reforming, coking and hydrotreating capacities are explicit
systematic_selection: All refinery rows if an official coordinate-bearing key becomes available
rationale: Joining addresses to geocoded points would infer coordinates.

official_source: EIA Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report
scope: Named fuel-ethanol, biodiesel and renewable-diesel plants with capacity
coordinate_availability: Facility spreadsheet lacks a confirmed source latitude/longitude field
technology_or_process_fields: Product category and capacity are explicit; fermentation technology is not
systematic_selection: All named fuel-ethanol plants if official source coordinates become available
rationale: City/state locations are not converted to inferred points, and ethanol is not automatically labelled with a reactor design.
